description: Your open editors as a vertical list in the sidebar, with groups, variants and git state.
view.bays.name: Bays
config.title: Bays
config.showFilePath: Show the relative file path as description next to each bay.
config.compactMode: Enable compact mode: bays show file name and path in a single line with reduced height (28px).
config.enableHoverActions: Show action buttons (file actions, Copilot, close) when hovering over a bay.
config.enableDragDrop: Enable drag & drop reordering of bays within and across groups.
config.syncCursorPosition: Synchronize cursor position (line and column) between parent bays and their children (diffs, snapshots, etc.). When enabled, moving the cursor in one bay will update all related bays.
config.animations: Master switch for everything the view moves: the close animation, the state-change pulse and the tooltip fade. It is also turned off by `workbench.reduceMotion`.
config.followProductIconTheme: Draw the panel's glyphs with the product icon theme selected in `workbench.productIconTheme`, like the rest of the workbench. Off, the panel keeps the codicons the extension ships, and nothing is read from disk.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Bays only reads the list of open editors and their git and diagnostic state. It never runs code from the workspace.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Bays works in a virtual workspace. File actions that need a file on disk, and git state, are not available there.
